crossRefs.note: Go up into Gilead, and take balm, virgin daughter of Egypt. You use many medicines in vain. There is no healing for you.
You daughter who dwells in Egypt, furnish yourself to go into captivity; for Memphis will become a desolation, and will…
Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us.
“Egypt is a very beautiful heifer; but destruction out of the north has come. It has come.
For, behold, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north,” says Yahweh. “They will come, and they will…
In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the twelfth day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: The daughter of Egypt will be disappointed; she will be delivered into the hand of the people of the north.”
translations.bsb: The Daughter of Egypt will be put to shame; she will be delivered into the hands of the people of the north.”
translations.kjv: The daughter of Egypt shall be confounded; she shall be delivered into the hand of the people of the north.
translations.asv: The daughter of Egypt shall be put to shame; she shall be delivered into the hand of the people of the north.
